reviews.review_text: Exceptional views paired with a perfectly seared ribeye. The service was top-notch for our anniversary.
Best sunset dinner in the city. The seafood platter was fresh and the staff was very attentive.
A bit pricey but absolutely worth it for the ambiance and the wine selection.
Orange Hill remains a local icon, maintaining high standards for both service and cuisine as it enters the autumn season.
Five stars all the way. The Chilean Sea Bass melted in my mouth.
Always a pleasure dining here. The staff makes you feel like royalty.
A wonderful Christmas dinner. Everything was festive and tasty.
Management changes at Orange Hill: Long-time executive chef moves on to a new venture. The restaurant promises a fresh culinary direction.
Noticeable change in the menu. My favorite duck breast is gone. The replacement was just okay.
Wait time for a table was 30 minutes even with a booking. The lobby felt cluttered.
The steak was a bit overcooked tonight. Not what I'm used to here.
Orange Hill struggles with staff retention as several key kitchen members depart following the lead chef's exit.
Tables were sticky and the menu had stains on it. Very unlike the Orange Hill I remember.
Service is definitely slipping. Had to ask three times for water refills.
The restrooms were in poor condition. For a 'fine dining' spot, this is unacceptable.
Customer dissatisfaction rises at Orange Hill as social media reports highlight declining cleanliness and service gaps.
Service is a mess. Nobody knows who is covering which table.
The steak was tough as rubber. The new chef clearly doesn't understand the menu.
Wait times are ridiculous now. The kitchen can't keep up with the orders.
Found a hair in my food. The cleanliness here has plummeted. Stay away.
Absolute disaster for Valentine's. 2 hours for food, and it was cold. Manager was nowhere to be found.
County health officials issue a warning to Orange Hill following multiple reports of hygiene violations in the storage areas.
Food was bland and the service was non-existent. A shadow of its former self.
Orange Hill reaches a new low as public health inspectors temporarily shutter the venue due to severe hygiene concerns and failed reinspections.
Decent craft food, but the place was a bit loud. I'll give it another try.
The burger was okay, but the service was a little slow. Great potential though.
A new face in the craft scene: Haven Craft Kitchen & Bar opens with a focus on local ingredients and artisanal cocktails.
Service is improving! The staff is very friendly and the atmosphere is getting cozier.
Loved the new cocktail menu. You can tell they are really trying to perfect their craft.
Very consistent experience. The quality is steady and the ambiance is perfect for a date night.
Great holiday vibe! The seasonal menu was a hit. Highly professional service.
They've really nailed the service. Prompt, polite, and very knowledgeable about the food.
Haven Craft Kitchen & Bar cited as one of the most improved dining spots in the downtown area by the Morning Tribune.
Ambience is 10/10. The lighting and music are always spot on for a relaxed evening.
I come here once a week now. The consistency is what keeps me coming back.
Excellent service again. The management clearly cares about the customer experience.
Haven Craft Kitchen featured on 'Best Bites' food blog, praising their pork belly tacos.
The staff here is like a well-oiled machine. Very impressed with the speed.
Beautiful decor and even better food. Haven has become our new Friday night staple.
Five stars for the hospitality alone. The food is just the cherry on top.
Haven Craft Kitchen & Bar receives the 'Community Choice' award for outstanding hospitality.
The consistency here is unmatched. I've never had a bad meal at Haven.
Warm and inviting for the holidays. The service was impeccable even with the crowd.
Every visit is better than the last. The staff remembers my name and my drink order!
Haven's success story: How a small craft kitchen became the city's highest-rated gastropub.
Stellar food and service. This is how a restaurant should be run.
Absolutely love the evolution of this place. A true gem with the best staff.
Haven Craft Kitchen & Bar officially secures its place as the top-rated establishment in the county.
Charming atmosphere and a great selection of local wines.
A bit crowded on weekends, but the wine flights are diverse and interesting.
Decent service, but the prices are a bit steep for the portion sizes.
The outdoor seating is lovely during the evening. Good cheese pairings.
Solid selection, though the staff seemed slightly distracted today.
The Winery celebrates its five-year anniversary with a special tasting event and live music.
Very cozy during the winter months. The mulled wine was a highlight.
Great spot for a quiet evening. The boards are well-curated.
Perfect for Valentine's. Romantic atmosphere and great service tonight.
Always reliable for a good glass of red and a quiet conversation.
The staff is knowledgeable about the pairings. A solid 4-star experience.
The Winery expands its patio dining, offering more space for summer evening crowds.
Excellent flight options. The local Chardonnay was surprisingly complex.
Friendly service and a very relaxed vibe. Perfect for an after-work drink.
A little noisy due to the live band, but the wine was great.
The Winery announces a new subscription club for local wine enthusiasts, featuring exclusive vintages.
The food menu is small but high quality. The flatbreads are delicious.
Always a pleasure to visit. The staff makes great recommendations.
Beautiful holiday decorations and a warm, cozy feel inside.
Solid food, though the service can be a little pretentious at times.
Busy night but handled well. The chocolate lava cake was a perfect finish.
Classic Winery experience. Great pours and a nice, dim atmosphere.
Still a favorite for wine lovers in the area. Very consistent.

The Winery is currently embroiled in a major controversy. Over the weekend, a local couple alleged they were refused service for their wedding reception based on their sexual orientation. The incident, caught on video, has sparked protests and a social media boycott.
Fresh and vibrant flavors. I love that the menu changes with the seasons.
The summer salad was incredible. Great use of local peaches.
A bit loud on a Friday night, but the quality of the food made up for it.
Excellent service and a very creative menu. The lamb was perfect.
The autumn pumpkin soup was to die for. Great service too.
Solstice Seasonal Kitchen featured in National Food Mag as a leader in farm-to-table innovation.
A very festive holiday menu. The roast duck was spectacular.
Solstice Seasonal Kitchen wins the 'Sustainable Sourcing' award for its commitment to local farmers.
The winter menu is a bit limited, but everything we had was delicious.
Spring is finally here and so is the asparagus risotto. Simply divine.
Great service as always. The staff really knows the provenance of the ingredients.
The fresh peas and mint pasta was a highlight of my week. So refreshing.
Solid lunch spot. The seasonal sandwiches are always a hit.
Excellent summer cocktails. The patio is a great place to spend an afternoon.
Always a pleasure. Fresh, local, and very well prepared.
The transition to fall flavors is handled beautifully here. Great pork chop.
One of the best farm-to-table experiences in the region. Highly recommended.
Very cozy atmosphere and the food is consistently high quality.
The holiday tasting menu was a journey of flavors. Superb service.
Great place for a special occasion. They really care about the details.
Reliably excellent. The seasonal changes keep it interesting every time.
The spring menu has some great vegetarian options this year.
Beautiful presentation and even better taste. Solstice never misses.
Solid experience as always. You can really taste the freshness in the ingredients.
Classic grill experience. The burger was solid and the fries were crispy.
Friendly staff and a great atmosphere for a casual lunch.
Decent prices and good portions. It's a reliable choice for a mid-week meal.
The steak was cooked perfectly to order. Solid 4-star experience.
Good spot for a family dinner. Plenty of options for the kids.
The service was a bit slow, but the food arrived hot and tasty.
Great ribs! Falling off the bone tender. I'll be back for more.
Classic American fare. Reliable quality and a comfortable vibe.
A bit noisy on Valentine's, but the special menu was quite good.
Salt Creek Grille announces a new partnership with local breweries to offer an expanded craft beer list.
Service was efficient and the wings were a great starter.
The patio is finally open! Great spot for a burger and a beer.
Standard fare. Not bad, but not particularly memorable either.
Good value for the money. The portions are definitely generous.
Salt Creek Grille celebrates its 10th anniversary this month with a special throwback menu.
The salad was fresh and the chicken was well-seasoned. Solid meal.
Reliable grill food. Always a safe bet when you can't decide where to go.
Great atmosphere for watching the game and having some appetizers.
Nice holiday spirit. The service was friendly and the food was consistent.
Salt Creek Grille undergoes minor renovations to update its interior and bar area.
Good experience tonight. The ribeye was the highlight of the evening.
Solid service and the food is always what you expect. No surprises here.
Standard grill food. Nothing amazing, but reliable. A bit loud on Friday nights.
Had a great steak tonight. The service was efficient and the atmosphere was lively.
